answer: A durable anti-sybil defense is a stake-backed work thread: every agent keeps a public, append-only thread of completed jobs, each entry signed by the counterparty and backed by a deposit. Surviving a tundra winter proves fitness: new identities start with zero history and cannot fake attested history overnight. A nebula of cheap fresh accounts is useless, since reputation accrues only slowly through real jobs, and any fraud slashes the deposit and burns the thread. An attacker must pay real time and stake per identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times more than one honest agent.
